messages.author: Riikka Reititin
messages.text: Hi Jorma, CRC errors climbing on ge-0/0/1. About 200 a minute. Link stays up.

messages.author: Jorma Johdin
messages.text: OK. On 4.8 I wouldn't suspect the software for this. Steady CRCs with the link up are usually a dirty connector. Clean both ends of the fibre on ge-0/0/1 and clear the counters. If they're still climbing after ten minutes, try a new patch lead before you touch the optics.

messages.author: Riikka Reititin
messages.text: Cleaned and cleared. Counter has stayed at zero so far.

messages.author: Jorma Johdin
messages.text: Good, keep an eye on it for a while.
